document.title: Form PENS.E/12 — Application for Emergency Fund Assistance

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/12 — Application for Emergency Fund Assistance
chunks.heading: What is Form PENS.E/12 used for?
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/12 ("Application for Emergency Fund Assistance") is used to apply for financial assistance from the UNJSPF Emergency Fund. This form is not applicable for active staff — it is for retirees and beneficiaries already receiving a periodic benefit.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/12 — Application for Emergency Fund Assistance
chunks.heading: What information is required in Sections 1 and 2?
chunks.text: Section 1 (Retiree or beneficiary information) requires the retiree's/beneficiary's UID, pension number, retirement number and full name. Section 2 (Applicant information) requires the applicant's full name, date of birth, mailing address, email and phone — the applicant may be the retiree/beneficiary themselves, their spouse, or an immediate dependant.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/12 — Application for Emergency Fund Assistance
chunks.heading: What is required in Section 3 (Nature of the Emergency)?
chunks.text: You must select the nature of the emergency (medical expenses — indicating whether the retiree/beneficiary has medical insurance —, funeral expenses, natural disasters, or other with specification), state the amount requested, and clearly describe the circumstances surrounding the financial hardship.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/12 — Application for Emergency Fund Assistance
chunks.heading: What does Section 4 (Bank Account Information) and Section 5 (Acknowledgement) require?
chunks.text: Section 4 requires standard bank account details (payee name, bank name, account number/IBAN, bank ID code, currency, account type, bank address, intermediary bank information). Section 5 requires confirming that the information is true and correct, that the instructions have been read, that supporting documents for the need and costs are included, and that a government photo ID and a recent bank statement/voided cheque are enclosed.
